preserved_primary_reviews.rationale: This is the clearest over-split in my assignment. The restoration promise runs as one unbroken chain of waw-consecutive perfects — וְשָׁב (v.3), וֶהֱבִיאֲךָ (v.5), וּמָל (v.6), וְנָתַן (v.7), וְהוֹתִירְךָ (v.9) — with וְנָתַן no more of an onset than the four links around it. A change of grammatical object (curses now falling on enemies) is not a change of formula. Both witnesses that could corroborate a division here decline to: the Masoretes hold 30:1-10 whole and place their strong mark only after v.10, and the WEB layout agrees. The draft's own rejected alternative concedes that a single return-and-restoration unit 'has some pull'; on this evidence it has more than pull.
